content: This paper has investigated gender bias in ASR performance through the following research questions: i) what is the proportion of men and women in French radio and TV media data ? ii) what is the impact of the observed disparity on ASR performance ? iii) is this as simple as a problem of gender proportion in the training data or are other factors entangled ?
